Charter Financial Corporation operates as the holding firm for CharterBank, a federally-chartered savings bank that provides various banking services and products to individuals and businesses in the United States. The company has market cap of $370.95 million. The company's deposit products include checking, money market, regular savings, and term certificate accounts, as well as noninterest-bearing demand deposits. It has a 27.97 P/E ratio. It also offers commercial real estate loans, one- to four-family residential mortgage loans, construction loans, and investment securities; and commercial business loans, home equity loans, and lines of credit, as well as other consumer loans, including loans on deposits, automobile loans, mobile home loans, and various other installment loans.
